# Basic: Custom Assets

This example shows how to inject custom styling (CSS) and logic (JavaScript) into the HTML bundle generated by Sivo.

## What is being tested/demonstrated
* Creating HTML tooltips with custom CSS classes.
* Defining raw CSS styles to apply to components generated by Sivo within the standalone HTML file.
* Injecting custom JavaScript into the generated HTML.
* Using `sivo_app.to_html()` with `custom_css` and `custom_js` arguments.

## Key Code

```python
sivo_app.map(
    element_id="sun",
    tooltip="The Custom Sun",
    html="<div class='custom-tooltip'><h3>The Custom Sun</h3><p>Styled with custom CSS!</p></div>"
)

# Custom CSS and JS to inject into the HTML template
custom_css = """
    .custom-tooltip {
        background-color: #333;
        color: #fff;
        padding: 10px;
        border-radius: 8px;
        box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
    }
    .custom-tooltip h3 {
        margin-top: 0;
        color: #f1c40f;
    }
"""

custom_js = """
    console.log('Hello from custom injected JS!');
"""

sivo_app.to_html(output_path, custom_css=custom_css, custom_js=custom_js)
```
